title: Kiln building blocks (blocks/*.json), format 1
description: A mod's blocks: spells, weapons, wands, armor, items, stations, statuses, effects, perks, abilities, talents, triggers and their parts, the same shape as the C# records (Kiln.Blocks). Read by managed/services/Kiln.Blocks/BlockJson.cs (System.Text.Json: comments and trailing commas allowed, unknown keys refused). A field that takes a block takes it inline, or by name: a block of this mod, or "other-mod:name".

statuses.description: Buffs and debuffs, made of effects.

effects.description: What happens: the same effect plugs in everywhere.

spells.description: Staff spells. A charge is one item in the stack.

weapons.description: Weapons that are made exactly as their recipe tooltip shows.

items.description: Anything else that goes in a bag: a material, a potion, food, an arrow, a tool. Its kind follows from what you fill in, or say it.

wands.description: One-handed casters whose attacks are spells of their own: no spell item, no charges.

armor.description: Things worn: made exactly as their recipe tooltip shows.

stations.description: Stations a player builds: a workbench, or a forge or rack that works on its own.

looks.description: Parts: what an item looks like. Use one by name wherever a field takes a look.

vfx.description: Effects written from nothing: particles and a light. No compiler, no game data. Built by the game client at start.

materialTweaks.description: Changes to game materials: what it takes to dig them. Read at boot by kiln.worldtables; a strength change asks nothing of players' games.

buildingMaterials.description: New building materials: an id and a GUID in the game's tables, and a block item. 49 fit across all mods. Needs "clients": "mod".

terrainMaterials.description: New terrain materials: ground, rock or ore, an id and a GUID in the game's tables. 11 fit across all mods, apart from the building materials. Needs "clients": "mod".

surfaces.description: Parts: how building materials look, defined once for materials of this mod to name.

strengths.description: Parts: what it takes to dig a material. Use one by name wherever a field takes a strength.

materials.description: Surfaces for models, on the game's own shaders. No base to name, no game data. Built by the game client at start.

screenEffects.description: Full-screen effects: colour grading, a tint, a vignette, fades and flashes. Drawn by each Kiln client; players' games need nothing for them.

armorStats.description: Parts: a piece of armor's numbers.

weaponClasses.description: Parts: your own class of weapon, starting from a premade.

armorSlots.description: Parts: your own slot, starting from a premade.

armorSets.description: Parts: a family of looks, one per slot: looks or worn looks.

onHits.description: Parts: what an item does to what its wearer hits.

sounds.description: Sounds of the mod's own: clips and how they play. kiln cook writes their steps into assets/cook.json (tools/soundcook blocks) and cooks them. An effect, a station or code plays one by its name. Players need the mod (clients "mod").

props.description: Things placed that stand there: furniture, banners, lamps.

placements.description: Parts: where and how a player can place something.

comforts.description: Parts: what the game's comfort counts.

processing.description: Parts: how a station works on its own.

menus.description: Parts: the crafting menu a station opens.

cosmetics.description: Pieces for the vanity slots: shown over what is worn there, with no stats. A look with files of the mod's own needs "clients": "mod".

wornLooks.description: Parts: what something looks like on the body. Use one by name wherever a field takes a worn look. The cook finds the files of every look here by itself.

perks.description: Enhancements for an item's perks: the game's rule applies, so one runs once a player has unlocked its slot.

abilities.description: What a character casts that is no staff's: on a key, a chat command, an item, or from code.

talents.description: Nodes of a skill tree: in the game's own tree with game, else parts for a talent tree. Needs "clients": "mod".

talentTrees.description: Whole trees of their own, on Kiln's screen. Needs "clients": "mod".

triggers.description: What a player does or is, any of the game's states and actions, driving effects.

creatures.description: Creatures: a body, how it moves, sees and fights.

npcs.description: Friendly NPCs: talk, wares, a place in the roster.

bodies.description: Bodies, for creatures and NPCs to name.

animations.description: Animations: clips of a glTF, cooked when the mod builds.

containers.description: Things that hold items, as the game's chests do: a lid, sounds and upgrades from the game's small chest.

doors.description: Doors: they open and close for whoever uses them, and paths and water follow them.

beds.description: Beds: the game's sleep and rest, comfort of the bed category; with Kiln a spawn point and a night slept through.

seats.description: Seats: the game's sitting, comfort of the chair category.

interactions.description: Parts: what happens when a player uses a placed thing. Use one by name in onInteract.

blueprints.description: New shapes for the game's building materials, half a metre a cell: a table each game merges at its start, so needs "clients": "mod".

hair.description: Hair styles: worn looks on the head. A look with files of the mod's own needs "clients": "mod".

beards.description: Beards: worn looks on the jaw. A look with files of the mod's own needs "clients": "mod".

lootTables.description: Tables of what drops, rolled by Kiln: a creature's drops name one, and so does code (LootTableHandle.Roll/Drop/Give). Server only.

recipes.description: Recipes of their own: one more way to make any item at a station, such as a game item at the game's workbench.

quests.description: Quest chains in the game's own journal: steps, objectives, conditions, rewards. Needs "clients": "mod".

dialogues.description: Conversations in the game's own NPC menu, for an NPC block's talk or a quest NPC's dialogue. Needs "clients": "mod".

windows.description: Windows and screens of rows: text, values, buttons, toggles and sliders on the mod's config. Drawn by each player's game from the mod's own file, so needs "clients": "mod"; on a dedicated server checked and kept, nothing drawn.

hudLines.description: Lines of text on the game's screen with values in them, a condition and a refresh rate. Needs "clients": "mod".

keyBindings.description: Keys that run an action (open a window, toggle a config value, run a command, cast an ability), rebindable in the Kiln menu. Needs "clients": "mod".

affixes.description: Affix kinds: rolled modifiers on one item ("+5 Strength" on this sword), a stat with tiers and the range each rolls in. A pool rolls them onto an item, and Kiln applies them while it is worn or in hand. Server; asks nothing of players' games. Rolled items keep the id "mod:name", the same as Affixes.Define gives.

affixPools.description: Affix pools: which items roll which affixes, and how many. Code rolls one onto an item (AffixPoolHandle.Roll); its entries name affixes of this mod's code or blocks files, in either order.

strength.description: What it takes to dig a material. Cost per block = health / (the tool's damage for this hardness x the server's mining factor x the class modifier). A field left out stays what it was.

hardness.description: The damage column a tool or an explosion uses. Unbreakable takes no damage from anything, and can't be dismantled.

health.description: Health points of a block. Rough Stone is 250, an Iron Block 2000.

breaks.description: The tool's class modifier that applies. none: 1.0, whatever the tool.

itemsPerBlocks.description: How many blocks dug give one loot item.

drops.description: The loot item: a game item's name or a GUID, or on a new material "block": its own block item. A new material that doesn't say gives back its recipe's first input at the recipe's ratio, as the game's blocks do.

surfacePng.description: A PNG in the mod's folder, a power of two on both sides, 4 to 4096.

iconPng.x-kiln-message: a PNG in the mod's folder by a path relative to it (no full path, no '..')
iconPng.description: A PNG icon in the mod's folder. Portable data files and lint require a relative path with no '..'. Item icons also accept a full path inside the owning mod's folder at runtime; status and perk PNGs require relative paths. A missing or refused optional PNG leaves the block defined with its base icon and an error.

surfaceValue.description: A PNG (its red channel) or a value 0 to 1.

surfaceLayer.description: One layer of a surface: maps of your own, a game material's layer ("game", "layer") with maps of yours on top, or the name of another layer of this surface.

albedo.description: Colour, sRGB. Required unless there is a tint or a game layer.

tint.description: Multiplies the albedo. Without one it is the colour.

normal.description: A normal map, green up as in glTF and Blender: a PNG, or { "map", "strength", "yDown" }.

height.description: For displacement and for blending layers. Default 0.5.

exposure.description: How much it follows the camera's exposure. Default 0.75.

gi.description: How much it lights its surroundings. Default 4.

tiling.description: How many times the maps repeat every 4 m. Default 1.

displacement.description: How far the height map pushes the surface, in metres. Default scale 0.1, offset -0.05 with a height map.

game.description: A game material this layer starts from: a GameMaterials name.

layer.description: Which of its layers. Default: the same as this one.

surface.description: What it sits on: floor, wall, ceiling, or several ("wall, ceiling"): the first is tried first.

buildingSurface.description: How a building material looks. On a new material a layer left out repeats side (edgeTop repeats edge); on a retexture it stays the game's.

bevel.description: Metres the edges are rounded by. Default 0.01.

edgeCurve.description: How the edge layer blends in, as the game keeps it: 1 a hard edge, 0.5 softer.

noiseRange.description: [start, full]: where the noise layer starts to show and where it covers all. Default [0.33, 0.75].

edgeOnlySide.description: The edge layer only on the sides of a block. Default true.

mapping.description: How the maps lie on a block. A roof material always maps as a roof.

decoration.description: A game material whose edge decoration it shows, or "none".

buildingSurfaceRef.description: A building surface, inline or by the name of one in this mod's surfaces sections.

strengthRef.description: A strength, inline or by name.

materialTweak.description: Changes a game material in place: what it takes to dig it, its pictures, or both.

material.description: The game material: a GameMaterials name, Cell<id>, or the material's GUID.

surface.description: New pictures: a layer written here replaces the game's, the rest stays. Asks nothing of other players.

name.description: The block item's name, as players read it.

roof.description: A roof material: the roof pieces list it, not the walls.

surface.description: How it looks. Without one, like the game's Rough Stone.

icon.x-kiln-message: item:<name>, or a PNG in the mod's folder by a path relative to it (no full path, no '..')
icon.description: The block item's picture: a PNG in the mod's folder, or item:<name>. Without one, each client draws a block of its surface.

was.description: The block's old name, after a rename: the material's id comes from it, so its walls stay in every world.

terrainMaterial.description: A new terrain material: it starts from a game terrain material and looks like one.

name.description: What players read: its item's name when it's placeable.

like.description: The game terrain material it starts from: a GameMaterials Terrain name or Cell<1..127>. Its strength, loot, sounds, friction and buffs come along. Default TerrainStone.

look.description: The game terrain material whose look it takes. Default: like's.

flatten.description: The game's flatten tool works on it. Default: like's.

sliding.description: Feet slide on it, as on ice. Default: like's.

placeable.description: It has an item the game's terrain shapes place, and digging gives it back. Default false: only found and dug, as the game's ores.

icon.x-kiln-message: item:<name>, or a PNG in the mod's folder by a path relative to it (no full path, no '..')
icon.description: The item's picture: a PNG in the mod's folder, or item:<name>. Default: the game's stone's.

recipe.description: How its item is made; needs placeable.

was.description: The block's old name, after a rename: the material's id comes from it, so its cells stay in every world.

name.description: The block's name. Ids come from your mod id and this: keep it. A rename says "was".

ref.description: A block of this mod by name, or "other-mod:name".

screenRef.description: A screen effect: its name, or one written here.

amount.description: How much of it, 0 to 1. Default 1.

screenEffect.description: A full-screen effect. Every field left out changes nothing. Graded in linear light: exposure and temperature, contrast, saturation, gamma, tint, vignette, fill; then mixed in by strength and the fades. Drawn over the frame the game presents, so over the game's UI too.

order.description: Several playing at once run lower first.

strength.description: How much of the whole effect shows. Default 1.

seconds.description: Seconds at full. Left out: until stopped; an effect's screen effect needs it. 0 with a fade out is a flash.

fadeOut.description: Seconds to fade once it ends or is stopped. Default 0.

exposure.description: Stops: 1 is twice as bright. Default 0.

gamma.description: Above 1 lifts the mid tones. Default 1.

temperature.description: -1 cold to 1 warm, keeping brightness. Default 0.

tint.description: A colour the picture is multiplied by.

radius.description: Where it starts: 0 the centre, 1 the corners. Default 0.5.

softness.description: How far past the radius it reaches full. Default 0.5.

vignette.description: Darker or coloured edges: how much (0.6), or { amount, color, radius, softness }.

fill.description: The whole picture goes to this colour by its amount: a fade to black, or a flash with a fade out.

range.description: Metres: when an effect plays it at a place, the players this near see it. Default 30.

was.description: The name this block had before a rename.

knockback.description: How far the hit pushes the target.

damage.description: Damage per kind. On a spell the first one is its main hit: the tooltip's number, and the staff's power adds to it unless flat. Elsewhere exactly this number. Armour and the attacker's stats apply after it.

flat.description: On a spell: exactly this number, with no share of the staff's power.

applies.description: A status put on the target.

area.description: Everything around the place gets these effects; who is in it is found when it happens.

vfx.description: A VFX where the area is, once. Its size is the VFX's own.

A VFX and where it shows: a VFX block of this mod by name, "other-mod:name", or "game:<name>" for one of the game's (a template that carries it, a sequence that plays it, or a GUID). A new VFX needs "clients": "mod".

offset.description: Metres from the slot, in the slot's own axes.

attach.description: Follows the slot while it plays (default), or stays where it started. What an effect spawns stays where the effect happened.

seconds.description: On an effect, how long it plays. Default: the VFX's own length.

parameters.description: Named parameters of a game VFX. Only on an effect: anything else starts the VFX from data a server can't lay out, and is refused at load. A name or type the VFX does not have does nothing.

tweak.description: Game fields this block does not cover, by the path a data pack writes, set on what it makes. They win over what the block sets.

effect.description: What happens. Parts run in this order: chance decides, area, spawns, vfx, sound, damage (with knockback and flinch), heal and restores, removes, applies, then.

on.description: Who it is for: what the trigger gives it (default), or the caster, whoever wields the weapon or cast the spell.

restores.description: Given back to the target. Less than 0 takes it away. A target without that attribute gets nothing.

removes.description: Statuses taken off the target: blocks by name, or the game's by their 0x id.

spawns.description: Spawned at the target or the place: a game template's name, or a template's GUID.

sound.description: A sound at the target or the place: a cue of this mod (needs clients: mod), "other-mod:name", or a cue's GUID.

screen.description: A full-screen effect for the target, when it is a player, or for the players near the place. It needs seconds.

chance.description: The whole effect happens this often.

then.description: More effects, on the same target.

casts.description: An ability the target casts, as from code: its costs and cooldown apply. With on: caster, whoever wields, wears or cast.

status.description: A buff or debuff, shown in the game's buff bar. It lasts its seconds, or while a player is in a state.

seconds.description: How long it lasts unless whoever applies it says otherwise. Not needed with while.

while.description: A player has it for as long as they are in this state.

look.description: Its icon and body effect. Default: a timer's icon for a debuff, a blessing's for a buff, and no body effect.

icon.x-kiln-message: a game status's id (0x<8 hex digits> or buff_<8 hex digits>), or a PNG in the mod's folder by a path relative to it (no full path, no '..')
icon.description: The icon, when it is not the look's: a game status by its id, whose icon it takes, or a PNG in the mod's folder (square, 256x256 as the game's; then clients "mod").

refreshes.description: Applied again while it runs: the timer starts over (true, the default), or the new one replaces the old.

modifies.description: Stats changed for as long as it runs. Whole-number stats take whole numbers; the rest are shares, 0.1 being 10%. A GUID names any other attribute (as a share).

screen.description: A full-screen effect on the screen of the player who has it, while they have it.

was.description: The name this block had before a rename. Ids come from the oldest name, so saves keep it.

cast.description: How a spell or an ability is cast: animation, timing, costs.

charges.description: How many a cast takes of a spell's stack or an ability's item. 0: none, used for ever. Default 1.

animation.description: The motion. A spell's default is fast-bolt; an ability's, none. On a spell an object changes it: like (a premade; default fast-bolt), animation, hitAt (the release, as releaseAt).

releaseAt.description: Seconds into the animation the spell leaves the staff.

projectile.description: It flies. What it strikes gets onHit, and where it stops onImpact happens.

gravity.description: 0 flies straight, 1 falls like a thrown stone (default 0.1).

onImpact.description: At the place it stops, which has no target of its own: use an area.

onHit.description: On the creature it strikes, if it struck one.

pierce.description: How many creatures it flies through, each struck once (onHit on each), before the next one stops it. Needs onHit. Anything that is not a creature stops it at once.

homing.description: It turns toward what it was aimed at, as the game's homing projectiles do.

turnSpeed.description: How fast it turns (default 20; the game's own run from 20 to 80).

seekRange.description: Metres along its aim it looks for what to turn to, when it was given no target (default 12).

placed.description: What every delivery that is not a flight has: it happens where it is placed, facing where the caster aims.

look.description: On a spell, what shows in the hand.

vfx.description: A VFX where it happens, facing where it goes.

delivery.description: How it gets there: a flight, or one of the deliveries placed where the caster is.

oneOf.description: Everyone in a cone in front of the caster.
Everyone along a line in front of the caster, through walls.

seconds.description: How long it keeps hitting, turning with the caster. 0 (default): one hit.

oneOf.description: A place that keeps hitting whoever is in it.

ahead.description: Metres in front of the caster (default 0).

oneOf.description: From the first in front of the caster on to the next within reach of each, never the same twice.

angle.description: How wide the caster looks for the first (default 120).

jumpRange.description: Metres from one to the next (default 6).

oneOf.description: Something spawned in front of the caster, as its child, at its level and of its faction.

template.description: A game template's name, or a template's GUID.

ahead.description: Metres in front of the caster (default 2).

seconds.description: When they are taken away. Default: they live on.

state.description: One of the game's player states or actions, by Kiln's name or the game's own (Gliding, HangGliding, ActionPrimary, Sitting, ...): docs/kiln/modding/player-states.md. A trigger also takes eating and eaten.

perk.description: An enhancement on an item, in its perks: it runs while the item is worn or in hand, once a player has unlocked that enhancement. A weapon's onHit is the same with no unlock.

value.description: The number the tooltip shows in front of the name: "5%", "12", "2.5", "8s". Default: what one modifies entry or one on-hit effect's chance says.

icon.x-kiln-message: a game perk, or a PNG in the mod's folder by a path relative to it (no full path, no '..')
icon.description: A game perk, whose icon it takes, or a PNG in the mod's folder (square, 256x256 as the game's; then clients "mod").

onHit.description: What every hit they land does to what was hit.

onKill.description: What a hit that kills does to what it killed.

onHitTaken.description: What every hit they take does to whoever dealt it.

ability.description: Cast on a key, a chat command, an item, or from code. It pays its costs, keeps its cooldown, then does what its delivery says. Its id is <mod>:<name>.

key.description: The default key ("G", "Shift+F"). Binding it needs the mod on the player's game: "clients": "mod".

command.description: A chat command that casts it, without the prefix.

item.description: An item that casts it when used. cast.charges is how many a cast takes of it.

aim.description: Where it aims (default forward). nearestEnemy: no enemy in range, no cast.

onCast.description: On the caster, the moment it leaves.

playersOnly.description: Keys and commands for players only (default).

talent.description: A node: in the game's own tree with game, or in a talent tree. It works for as long as a character has it.

maxLevel.description: Levels (default 1). The game's tree keeps at most 7.

requires.description: In a tree: its node names. In the game's tree: talents of this mod by name, or game nodes by 0x id.

requireAll.description: In a tree: all of requires, not any one.

pointsSpent.description: In a tree: points spent in it first.

characterLevel.description: In a tree: the character level needed.

keeps.description: A status they have for as long as they have the talent.

onStart.description: On them when it starts to work: at the unlock and at each join.

unlocks.description: An ability only those with this talent can cast.

icon.description: A PNG in the mod's folder.

game.description: A place in the game's own tree: its screen draws it, its skill points pay for it.

from.description: Game nodes by 0x id that lead here.

offset.description: [x, y] from the node it hangs on.

talentTree.description: A whole tree on Kiln's screen in the game's look. Kiln keeps each character's unlocks with the character.

points.description: Where its points come from (default 1, and 1 more per character level).

shareOfGame.description: A share of the game's skill points instead.

respec.description: Everything can be given back for free (default).

nodes.description: Node name -> a talent, inline or by name. Keep the names: saves hold them.

trigger.description: A state entered, an action started, or a consumable eaten, driving effects on the player. Runs on the server world.

item.description: Only with this item: what an action uses, what is eaten, or for a state what is in hand or worn.

when.description: Only while the player is in one of these.

unless.description: Not while the player is in any of these.

onEnd.description: When they leave the state. A state only.

stop.description: Stops the action, or the eating.

station.description: "hand" (the default): the player's own menu; a workshop's 0x id; or a station block by name. In a station's list of recipes: that station, so leave it out.

makes.description: How many one craft gives. For a spell: charges.

needs.description: Item -> count: a game item, an item of this mod by its block name, or "other-mod:name".

burns.description: Fuel each cycle burns, item -> count. An input, as in the game's data: with none left the station stops.

seconds.description: Seconds at a station that works on its own. Needed at one with a workshop of its own.

output.description: What it makes: in a station's list of recipes, and in a recipes block of its own, where it is needed. Elsewhere a recipe makes the block it is on.

sheltered.description: A player crafts it only under a roof. A station that works on its own never checks a roof, so its recipes refuse it.

comfort.description: The comfort level it asks of whoever makes it.

needsProps.description: Props that have to stand near a manual station: blocks with provides, by name ("other-mod:name" for another mod's). The game's automated factory path has no nearby-prop context, so factory block recipes refuse this field.

onCast.description: On the caster, the moment it leaves the staff.

rarity.description: What a made item is: its colour, and how many enhancements it can have (one more than the rank).

level.description: The tooltip's level; a made item has exactly this.

itemRef.description: An item: a game item (Material_T1_Twigs), an item of this mod by its block name, or "other-mod:name".

visual.description: What an item looks like. Empty: its starter's look.

like.description: An item whose whole look this takes: held or worn model, dropped model, collection model and icon.

model.description: The model alone: item:<name>, or the GUID of a model your assets/assets.json serves (then clients "mod").

icon.x-kiln-message: item:<name>, an item's GUID, or a PNG in the mod's folder by a path relative to it (no full path, no '..')
icon.description: The icon alone: item:<name>, or a PNG in the mod's folder (then clients "mod").

dropped.description: An item whose model this shows lying on the ground.

tint.description: The colour of the parts the game lets you tint.

vfx.description: A VFX on the thing itself while it is there: in the hand while held (right hand, at the grip, by default), or on what stands there for a placed thing.

animatedModel.description: A held model with moving parts: a skinned model of the mod's and the graph that plays its clip, held in the class's hand with the look's vfx on it (then clients "mod"). Each is a GUID or the name of its model or graph step of assets/cook.json.

model.description: The skinned model: a GUID or its model step's name.

graph.description: The graph that plays its clip: a GUID or its graph step's name.

leftModel.description: Daggers only: the left hand's model. Default: model.

leftGraph.description: Daggers only: the left hand's graph. Default: graph.

visualRef.description: A look: inline, or a block of looks by name.

onHit.description: What an item does to what its wearer hits.

vfx.description: A VFX where each hit lands.

hits.description: A list of effects, a block of onHits or an effect by name, or an onHit inline.

perks.description: Enhancement slots, from the first: a game perk's name or GUID, item:<name> (that item's perk in the same slot), "none", or null to keep the slot's. The game's rule applies: a perk runs once its slot is unlocked.

dropPlace.description: A place in the game's drop tables: table or dropsLike, one of them.

table.description: A table's GUID or a glob over GUIDs.

dropsLike.description: Every table that drops this item, next to it.

weight.description: Where the table picks one of several.

loot.description: Where it can be found, besides being made.

like.description: It is rolled in chests and world pickups where this item is, with its chances.

tables.description: The game's own drop tables it goes into: what enemies and fixed chests hold. A table of your own is a lootTables block.

rolled.description: Gear only: a roll gives it a level and rarity of its own. The opposite of the crafted-item rule, so it refuses a recipe (KL406).

lootEntry.description: One stack a table can give.

countMax.description: How many, at most. Left out: the same as countMin.

chance.description: How often it gives anything when it comes up (default 1). With pick "one", after it was picked.

weight.description: With pick "one": how likely it is the one picked, among the table's (default 1).

lootTable.description: A table of what drops. Kiln rolls it on the server, apart from the game's own loot: it needs no clients of its own.

rolls.description: How many times the table rolls (default 1). What comes up is added together per item.

pick.description: What one roll does: "each" (the default) tries every entry's chance; "one" picks one entry by weight, then its chance.

weaponStats.description: A weapon's numbers: the tooltip's, made exactly so.

power.description: The tooltip's damage at that level. Default: what the class has, or damage's total.

damage.description: The kinds it deals: the shares of the kinds that hurt count; wood, stone and metal are exact.

staminaCost.description: Stamina each use costs; the tooltip follows.

weaponClass.description: Your own class of weapon. It brings its look, stats and perks to the weapons of the class.

weaponClassRef.description: How it is held and swung: a premade, a block of weaponClasses by name, or your own.

source.description: Where to get it, in the tooltip. Not given: nothing.

onHit.description: What every hit the wielder lands does to the target, while it is in hand, with no unlock.

onKill.description: What a hit that kills does to what it killed, while it is in hand.

weaponMoves.description: What its attack slots play, slot by slot; a slot left out keeps its class's. A slot the class does not have is refused.

primary.description: The light attack on the ground: one move, or a chain whose links hand over in turn.

heavy.description: The heavy attack on the ground: one move or a chain.

heavyAir.description: The heavy attack in the air. Default: primary's first link when primary is given.

block.description: No hitAt: a block lands no blow.

parry.description: No hitAt: a parry lands no blow.

move.description: One move. At least one field: a move with none changes nothing.

like.description: The game sequence it starts from: a sub-sequence name or a sequence GUID. Default: the class's in this slot.

hitAt.description: Seconds into the move its blow lands: the first damage event moves here.

moveAnimation.description: The state it plays: a state of this mod by name, a game state ("State" or "Machine/State"), its GUID or its 0x id; or a list, one per state event of the motion (null keeps one).

wandAttack.description: One of a wand's attacks: how it is cast and what it sends.

cast.description: The mana it costs and when it leaves the wand. animation is a staff's: a wand's motion is moves.

onCast.description: On the caster, the moment it leaves the staff.

moves.description: The motion. Default: the attack slot's own. An object changes it: like (a premade; default the slot's own), animation, hitAt (the release, as cast.releaseAt).

source.description: Where to get it, in the tooltip. Not given: nothing.

primary.description: Its main damage is the wand's power: the tooltip's number, and what perks and stats scale.

heavy.description: Default: the primary again. Its damage is exactly what it says.

special.description: Once a player has the game's skill for it. Default: the primary again. Its damage is exactly what it says.

armorStats.description: What a piece of armor gives. A number left out: what its slot has at that level.

resist.description: Armour against one kind, on top of the two above.

bonus.description: What wearing it adds; the tooltip follows. A share (melee-damage) is 0.05 for 5%.

armorSlot.description: Your own slot: it brings its look and stats to the pieces worn there.

armorSet.description: A family of looks, one per slot.

source.description: Where to get it, in the tooltip. Not given: nothing.

set.description: A family of looks: this takes the look the set has for its slot. visual wins over it.

look.description: What it looks like on the body: a model of the mod's own. It wins over visual for what is worn; visual still gives the dropped model and the tint.

onHitTaken.description: What every hit the wearer takes does to whoever dealt it, while it is worn, with no unlock.

tool.description: What a tool does: what it is for, and how well. Each class takes the fields it has a number for.

harvests.description: wood: an axe. stone: a pickaxe, for stone and metal, and it digs. rake: flattens the ground. sieve: the mining sieve. glider, grappling-hook, fishing-rod, torch: the game's.

power.description: How hard it bites: an axe's wood damage, a pickaxe's or a sieve's stone damage (the rest scales along), a rake's flattening strength (the game's: 500, 1000).

staminaCost.description: Stamina each use costs; the tooltip follows. Not for a fishing rod or a torch.

range.description: Metres: how far a rake flattens around where it aims (3), how far a grappling hook reaches (13.5).

durability.description: Seconds a torch burns while held, the tooltip's Duration (600). Only a torch.

breaksInto.description: What it becomes when its durability runs out: a game item or an item of this mod. A torch, or a tool with enhancement slots.

fishing.description: A fishing rod's pull and stamina.

ammo.description: What an arrow adds to the bow that shoots it.

power.description: The power it adds to the bow's. Default: damage's total, or an arrow's own.

damage.description: The kinds it deals: the shares count, as for a weapon.

delivery.description: A flight of its own. Default: an arrow's.

item.description: Its kind follows from what you fill in: tool, ammo, feeds, heals or onUse, else a material. A water container (watering-can, water-pouch) is named by kind.

source.description: Where to get it, in the tooltip. Not given: nothing.

kind.description: watering-can and water-pouch: the game's water containers; holds and flow are theirs.

stack.description: How many fit in a stack. Default: the kind's own. A tool does not stack.

heals.description: Health using it gives at once; the tooltip's number.

onUse.description: What using it does, to whoever uses it.

feeds.description: The status eating it gives, in the game's food slots.

onEat.description: On whoever used it, once the item has really gone.

canEat.description: When it can be used. Refused, the item stays and gives nothing.

fuel.description: Seconds it burns in a fire.

comfort.description: The comfort a placed one gives.

holds.description: A water container's capacity, in charges: the game's watering can holds 100, its pouch 20 sips. At most 1023: players' games are sent the water as charges x 64 in 16 bits. Default: the kind's own.

flow.description: How fast a water container fills and pours (at a lake, a well or a barrel, onto crops and soil), as a multiple of the game's own: what one step moves, 32 for the can, 16 for the pouch, about 20 steps a second. The game has no rate for filling alone. Default: 1.

station.description: A station a player builds: a prop that makes things. With processing it works on its own, over time, from its own inventory, like a forge; without, a player crafts at it at once, like a workbench.

tweakPlaced.description: The same, set on the template it places (templates section paths).

visual.description: Its look: like (a game item that places something: model, collision and how it places), or model (item:<name>, or the GUID of a model your assets/assets.json serves).

onInteract.description: What happens when a player uses it.

light.description: A VFX on it for as long as it stands: where the game's lamps have their light.

recipe.description: How the item that places it is made.

kind.description: The game's station it starts from: model, collision, sound and the menu it opens. Default: drying-rack with processing, else workbench.

ownWorkshop.description: A workshop of its own, which decides which recipes it runs. Default: yes for a kind that works on its own, with processing or recipes.

recipes.description: What it makes, each with output.

provides.description: A recipe elsewhere can ask for it nearby (needsProps). It takes one of the game's 13 free places for crafting props, in every game that has the mod; a prop of code is there from the second start. Needs "clients": "mod".

sound.description: A sound of the mod's own: one or more clips (each play picks one), how loud and how far it carries.

clips.description: Audio files in the mod's folder: WAV, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, MP3. Mono for a sound with a range.

range.description: [min, max] metres: full volume within min, silent beyond max. Without: heard alike everywhere (UI, music).

loop.description: It plays until stopped: a station's running sound, an ambience.

scene.description: The player's volume slider it follows.

pitchRandomness.description: How much each play's pitch varies.

normalize.description: The sources' active RMS in dBFS, as the cook sets it (the game's effects: about -23).

prop.description: Something placed that stands there: furniture, a banner, a lamp.

tweakPlaced.description: The same, set on the template it places (templates section paths).

visual.description: Its look: like (a game item that places something: model, collision and how it places), or model (a glTF in the mod's folder, which kiln cook makes into the game's model; item:<name>; or the GUID of a model your assets/assets.json serves).

collider.description: What a player bumps into and hits stop at: one box, in metres. Default with a glTF model: the box around the model. Only with a model of yours.

center.description: [x, y, z] of its centre from the model's origin. Default: standing on the floor, half its height up.

colliders.description: Several boxes in place of one, all solid, together one shape in the template: a table's top and legs, a doorway's two posts. The same rules as collider. The box the cursor checks for room stays one: the box around them all.

center.description: [x, y, z] of its centre from the model's origin. Default: standing on the floor, half its height up.

onInteract.description: What happens when a player uses it.

light.description: A VFX on it for as long as it stands: where the game's lamps have their light.

recipe.description: How the item that places it is made.

provides.description: A recipe elsewhere can ask for it nearby (needsProps). It takes one of the game's 13 free places for crafting props, in every game that has the mod; a prop of code is there from the second start. Needs "clients": "mod".

placement.description: Where and how a player can place it. A field left out: what its starter does.

size.description: Metres, width, height, depth: the box that has to be free, standing on its floor.

snap.description: The cursor starts out snapping to the voxel grid.

fog.description: It can be placed below the Shroud's line.

consumed.description: Placing it takes the item from the stack.

comfort.description: What the game's comfort counts, for whoever rests within range. Only the best of a category counts.

warmth.description: Resistance to the cold near it. Default 1.

processing.description: How a station works on its own. A field left out: what its kind does.

slots.description: Inventory slots, inputs and outputs in one.

sound.description: A looping sound: a cue of this mod (then clients "mod"), "other-mod:name", or a cue's GUID.

menu.description: The crafting menu a station opens: an existing station's, which lists the station's recipes among its own.

fits.description: What a look makes the rest of the character do: "hood" gives hair its hood cut. A name, or a list of names.

bodyPart.description: A body part, or what is worn in a slot. Hidden, it is not drawn.

wornModel.description: A .glb or .gltf in the mod's folder, item:<name> for a game item's model, or the GUID of a model the mod's assets.json serves.

wornLook.description: What something looks like on the body: a model of your own or a game item's, what it hides and how the rest of the character fits around it.

like.description: A game item, or an item of this mod, whose whole look this takes. What else the look says wins.

model.description: Skinned on the player's skeleton, or a plain mesh with attach. A morph target named Female is the shape on a female body.

female.description: A second file for a female body, instead of a morph target.

variants.description: Whole models for what the character wears or is: "shield", "female+tight". The most specific that applies is drawn, and model otherwise.

hides.description: What is not drawn while this is worn. Nothing else is hidden.

attach.description: A rigid model: a mesh with no skin, on this slot or j<index>. Its origin is the joint.

lods.description: Coarser files of model, from the next level on.

pixelSizes.description: When each level shows: one per level, 0 first, rising.

materials.description: A glTF material's name, or "*" for every one, to a material block's name or a game material's GUID. One it leaves out becomes a block of its own.

icon.x-kiln-message: item:<name>, or a PNG in the mod's folder by a path relative to it (no full path, no '..')
icon.description: A PNG in the mod's folder, or item:<name>. Default: the game draws the model.

armorLook.description: A set's look for a slot: a look, a worn look, or either by name.

wornLookRef.description: A worn look: inline, or a block of wornLooks by name.

cosmetic.description: A piece for a vanity slot: it shows over what is worn there, with no stats of its own and none taken away.

slot.description: Which vanity slot it goes in.

dyes.description: Takes the game's dyes, where its material has a tint mask. Default false.

animClip.description: What a state plays: a glTF animation's name, or { "clip": name, ... }, or { "blend": ... }.

then.description: The state it moves on to when its clip ends.

reference.description: On hit: the animation its pose is relative to.

input.description: moveDirection, hitDirection, lookYaw, ..., or a name of your own.

animLayer.description: Played over the states: always, or on an overlay.

animation.description: How a body moves: a glTF of the mod with its clips (cooked when the mod builds), the engine's states and your own. Or a premade: "like".

clips.description: The glTF file, its path in the mod's folder.

retarget.description: The clips are authored on a rig of their own: play them on "skeleton" (a body's) by pairing joints. Each paired joint turns as its source turns; translations carry over on the hips, scaled by the rigs' heights.

map.description: The clip file's joint -> the skeleton's joint. Joints of the same name pair by themselves.

byName.description: Pair joints of the same name that map leaves out. Default true.

translate.description: The clip file's joints whose movement carries over. Default: the hips.

scale.description: How far translations go. Default: the rigs' hip heights.

reference.description: A pose of the clip file that shows the body's rest posture, when the file's rest pose doesn't.

template.description: A game creature whose graph this is.

states.description: States of your own, by name.

stagger.description: What a hit reaction, a stun or a parry plays over the whole body. Default: the hit clip once, else Idle.

body.description: What a creature is: a skinned glTF of the mod, or a game creature's body ("like").

slots.description: The game's attachment slots on joints: { "HandR": "hand_r" }.

ai.description: How it notices and chases: a game creature's tuning to start from, and what to change.

tune.description: Any field of the game's AI by path.

nightSight.description: Share of its sight at night.

hears.description: False: it does not react to noise.

hearing.description: Share of the game's noise ranges.

threat.description: How much it draws enemies' attention, 1 as the game has it.

roam.description: How it wanders (turns the game's Roaming on).

flee.description: How it runs from a fight.

below.description: Share of its health it runs at.

returnsHome.description: False: it never walks home after a fight.

enable.description: The game's AI features to turn on, comma separated (EnemyFeatures names).

disable.description: The game's AI features to turn off, comma separated.

relations.description: Faction name -> how this creature treats it.

senseFilter.description: A sense filter registered with Blocks.SenseFilter.

condition.description: A rule's condition: healthBelow, healthAbove, targetWithin, targetBeyond, hasBuff, time, night, day, inPhase, custom, not, inCombat, state, hasTarget, targetIsPlayer, targetHealthBelow, hitWithin, chance, targetAtHome, enemiesNear, alliesNear, summonsBelow, or one of the game's { "type": ... }.

action.description: A rule's action: setPhase, attack, custom, { "effect": ..., "on": "target" | "self" }, flee, backOff, play, immune, pause, enableFeature, disableFeature, heal, summon, cast, { "apply": ..., "on": ... }, or one of the game's { "type": ... }.

rule.description: On a trigger, every so often, when its conditions hold, do something.

creatureAttack.description: An attack: the state it plays, its reach, what its blow does.

behaviour.description: What a creature does: attacks and rules on top of the game's combat AI, or a brain.

perception.description: How the brain sees. Only with a brain. Left out: distance and faction.

occlusion.description: voxels: a candidate behind terrain or a building is not seen (Queries.VoxelLineOfSight); one whose line cannot be checked is not seen either.

perceptionOffset.description: Metres along the world's axes (y up), added to the entity's position. Default 0, 1.5, 0.

creature.description: A creature: its body, animation, AI and behaviour.

drops.description: What it drops when it dies, besides what the game gives it: a lootTables block by name, or a table written here. Kiln rolls it where the death is reported.

npc.description: A friendly NPC on a game NPC's body: talk, wares, a place in the roster.

talk.description: A dialogue block or quests/*.json dialogue of this mod. Another mod's dialogue is not supported by the startup build.

inBase.description: A base is fine (default true): a friendly NPC comes as near as distance asks while the player is home. false: 20 m outside every base zone.

exact.description: Exactly at: no ground, no base check.

interactionRef.description: An interaction: inline, or a block of interactions by name.

interaction.description: What happens when a player uses a placed thing. A field left out is what its starter does. verb, plays, toggle and the game's lock in requires are the game's own; effects and requires' when, unless are Kiln's, on the server.

verb.description: The prompt's word: one of the game's, so every language has it.

prompt.description: A prompt of your own instead of verb: the same text in every language.

plays.description: What the player plays: one of the game's interaction sequences, or a sequence's GUID.

toggle.description: Two states, and each use flips it, as a door's: the guest's sequence flips it. A prompt left out is its starter's.

on.description: The prompt while it is off: one of the game's words.

off.description: The prompt while it is on: one of the game's words.

onPrompt.description: A prompt of your own while it is off. Wins over on.

offPrompt.description: A prompt of your own while it is on. Wins over off.

startsOn.description: It is on when placed: a door stands open.

effects.description: What happens to the player once the game has accepted the use.

onRefused.description: What happens to the player when requires' when or unless refuses them.

requires.description: What it takes to use it. item, count, uses and time are the game's own lock, shown in the player's game; when and unless are checked by Kiln on the server.

item.description: An item in the player's bag.

uses.description: The use takes item from the bag, as a lockpick goes.

time.description: Only by day, or only by night.

when.description: Only while the player is in one of these.

unless.description: Not while the player is in any of these.

spot.description: Where the player sits or lies: metres from the thing's origin in its own axes, and which way they face, in degrees.

blueprint.description: A new shape on the game's building materials: beside the walls and floors in the build menu, taking every material they take.

cells.description: Layers from the bottom up; in a layer, rows from the back to the front; in a row, # a cell and . or a space none. Half a metre a cell, 32 at most each way.

roof.description: A roof shape: it cycles through the roof materials.

cost.description: Obsolete and not used: a placement takes one block of the chosen material per cell it fills, as the game's own shapes do.

hair.description: A hair style: a worn look on the head. A morph target named Female is its shape on a female head; Hat and Hood the cut under a hat or a hood.

beard.description: A beard: a worn look on the jaw. A morph target named Female is its shape on a female head.

container.description: Something that holds items. Starts from the game's small chest; visual.like names another.

tweakPlaced.description: The same, set on the template it places (templates section paths).

visual.description: Its look: like (a game item that places something: model, collision and how it places), or model (item:<name>, or the GUID of a model your assets/assets.json serves).

onInteract.description: What happens when a player uses it.

light.description: A VFX on it for as long as it stands: where the game's lamps have their light.

recipe.description: How the item that places it is made.

provides.description: A recipe elsewhere can ask for it nearby (needsProps). It takes one of the game's 13 free places for crafting props, in every game that has the mod; a prop of code is there from the second start. Needs "clients": "mod".

defaultLoot.description: What it holds when it is placed: a lootTables block by name, or a table written here. Kiln rolls it on the server and gives the stacks into the container once for each container it finds (after a restart, or placed again on the same spot, it is not filled again). A container a player can make is filled at each new spot.

lid.description: How its lid moves: the game's toggle animation. A client sight. A field left out is the starter's.

moves.description: False: nothing moves (a barrel, a model of yours with no lid): the toggle animation is taken off. Default true.

graph.description: The animation graph that moves it, by GUID (kiln catalog graphs lists the game's, with their states). Default: the starter's.

openState.description: The graph's state while open, by GUID. Default: the game's open state (bcf39dc8-d81e-450a-a77d-3b626d4106c4).

shutState.description: The graph's state while shut, by GUID. Default: the game's shut state (48775f5b-13ed-442a-9c6e-cec65ae16342).

door.description: A door. Starts from the game's wooden door; visual.like names another.

tweakPlaced.description: The same, set on the template it places (templates section paths).

visual.description: Its look: like (a game item that places something: model, collision and how it places), or model (item:<name>, or the GUID of a model your assets/assets.json serves).

onInteract.description: What happens when a player uses it.

light.description: A VFX on it for as long as it stands: where the game's lamps have their light.

recipe.description: How the item that places it is made.

provides.description: A recipe elsewhere can ask for it nearby (needsProps). It takes one of the game's 13 free places for crafting props, in every game that has the mod; a prop of code is there from the second start. Needs "clients": "mod".

opens.description: Which way it swings. both: away from whoever uses it, as the game's wooden door. front or back: always that way, whichever side the player stands on. A client sight; the angle is in the animation. Default: the starter's.

sides.description: Which side a player can use it from (default both). A player on the other side is declined, as Kiln's other checks decline. Kiln's, on the server.

bed.description: A bed: the game's sleep and rest. Starts from the game's wooden bed; visual.like names another.

tweakPlaced.description: The same, set on the template it places (templates section paths).

visual.description: Its look: like (a game item that places something: model, collision and how it places), or model (item:<name>, or the GUID of a model your assets/assets.json serves).

onInteract.description: What happens when a player uses it.

light.description: A VFX on it for as long as it stands: where the game's lamps have their light.

recipe.description: How the item that places it is made.

provides.description: A recipe elsewhere can ask for it nearby (needsProps). It takes one of the game's 13 free places for crafting props, in every game that has the mod; a prop of code is there from the second start. Needs "clients": "mod".

lies.description: Where the player lies. Default: the starter's spot.

spawnPoint.description: A player who dies comes back at the last of these beds they slept in. Kiln's, on the server.

skipsNight.description: When every player in the world sleeps at night in such beds, the morning comes. Kiln's, on the server.

seat.description: A seat: the game's sitting. Starts from the game's wooden chair; visual.like names another.

tweakPlaced.description: The same, set on the template it places (templates section paths).

visual.description: Its look: like (a game item that places something: model, collision and how it places), or model (item:<name>, or the GUID of a model your assets/assets.json serves).

onInteract.description: What happens when a player uses it.

light.description: A VFX on it for as long as it stands: where the game's lamps have their light.

recipe.description: How the item that places it is made.

provides.description: A recipe elsewhere can ask for it nearby (needsProps). It takes one of the game's 13 free places for crafting props, in every game that has the mod; a prop of code is there from the second start. Needs "clients": "mod".

sits.description: Where the player sits. Default: the starter's spot.

questPos.description: Metres: [x, y, z]. x east, y up, z north.

questPlace.description: A place found at run time: on real ground (the voxel surface), outside every base, not too steep; one per world. Say what it is near: near ("player", or an NPC), or at.

near.description: "player" (who gets there first), or an NPC: an NPC block of this mod by its name, or an id of the mod's quests/*.json.

distance.description: Metres from what it is near: [min, max]. It widens by itself until a good spot is found.

margin.description: Metres to keep from a base's build zone (default 20).

inBase.description: A base is fine (never for enemies: the game pacifies them there and may remove them).

exact.description: Exactly at: no ground, no base check.

questSpawn.description: Creatures the step brings into the world: on real ground outside every base, never saved, checked every second, spawned again when the game removes them, and after a restart or rejoin as many as are still owed. Where: the step's site, or at, near and distance here.

tag.description: The Kiln.Spawn tag: a kill objective can name it.

level.description: The level to spawn at (0: the template's).

retries.description: How many times they come back when the game removes them (default 5). Then kiln.log has an error.

questMarker.description: The step's map marker. A step with a place (site, spawn, a reach or kill place, an NPC to talk to or deliver to) has one by itself; this names it or moves it. false: none.

waypoint.description: Also write the player's waypoint, the game's own map and compass pin (default true).

name.description: The map marker's name; default the step's text.

base.description: The marker template to copy (default a search-area label).

questNpc.description: An NPC: an NPC block of this mod by its name, an id of the mod's quests/*.json, "other-mod:npc".

questObjective.description: One of kill, collect, deliver, reach, talk, craft, build, knowledge, custom.
questObjective.x-kiln-message: an objective needs one of kill, collect, deliver, reach, talk, craft, build, knowledge, custom

text.description: Shown instead of the step's text when a step has several objectives.

kill.x-kiln-message: kill needs template, family or tag
kill.description: A death credited to the player (a world quest: any death).

countDestroyed.description: Kiln.Spawn destroying a match counts too.

collect.description: What the inventory holds now. Takes nothing.

deliver.description: Takes the items when an advance action or the NPC's hand-over finishes it.

reach.x-kiln-message: reach needs at, offset, marker or site
reach.description: Being there, checked twice a second.

offset.description: Metres from where the player stood when the step started.

marker.description: A template's name: the nearest entity of it.

site.description: The step's site is the place.

node.description: Reaching a node of a chat conversation.

craft.description: A successful craft by the player.

knowledge.description: The game's knowledge holds it: npc:…, quest:…, query:…, 0x….

custom.description: A signal name, or the signal and how many: Quests.Signal, the signal action, or a C# progress function.

questCondition.description: One of knowledge, level, quest, step, item, predicate, all, any, not. Checked on the server, also when an option is chosen.
questCondition.x-kiln-message: a condition needs one of knowledge, level, quest, step, item, predicate, all, any, not

level.description: The character's level is at least this.

quest.description: A quest of this mod (or "other-mod:quest"), in the state is.

is.description: Quest: locked, available, active, done, failed, started. Step: pending, active, done. Default done.

item.description: At least count of it are in the inventory.

questAction.description: One of xp, item, take, knowledge, revoke, start, complete, fail, advance, reset, spawn, despawn, teleport, chat, talk, signal, call. In an option's do the first failing action stops the rest; in rewards and hooks each failure is logged and the rest runs.
questAction.x-kiln-message: an action needs one of xp, item, take, knowledge, revoke, start, complete, fail, advance, reset, spawn, despawn, teleport, chat, talk, signal, call

item.description: Gives count of it (what does not fit lands at the player's feet).

count.description: Items given or taken, spawned entities.

revoke.description: Clears that id only: what the game already did because of it stays.

target.description: knowledge, revoke: default the player's object if the id has one, else the world's.

value.description: knowledge: a counter's amount or a flag's number.

flag.description: revoke: one flag of a Flags object.

advance.description: Finishes a step: "quest.step". Refused for unfinished kill, collect and reach objectives unless force.

spawn.description: A one-off creature near the player or at at, on the ground outside bases. For creatures a step needs, use the step's spawn.

despawn.description: The tag of what spawn made.

offset.description: Metres from the player, instead of at.

bindNpc.description: The spawned entity becomes this NPC.

exact.description: Exactly at: no ground, no base check.

chat.description: A chat line for the player.

talk.description: Opens a chat conversation: a dialogue of this mod, at node.

questReward.description: What a quest or a step pays, all at once: experience, items, a status, knowledge. Each part is paid on its own: one that cannot be (a full inventory drops the rest at the player's feet) is logged and the others still are. A world quest pays every player in game.

xp.description: Experience, through the game's quest path.

items.description: Item and count: a game item, or an item this mod defines.

status.description: A status put on the player: a status block of this mod, or a game status; its own time, or seconds.

knowledge.description: The game's knowledge granted: npc:….unlock unlocks an NPC.

lootTable.description: A loot table rolled when the reward is paid: the name of a lootTables block of this mod (or "other-mod:name"). What comes up is given like items. A name that is no loot table refuses the quest.

questStep.description: One step of a quest. It is done when all its objectives are.

id.description: Letters, digits, '_' and '-'; unique in the quest. Keep it: progress is filed under it.

title.description: The journal's short line (the list, the tracked quest). Default its text.

voice.description: A voice-over line in the journal: a name of the mod's cooked audio, or a GUID.

spawn.description: Creatures the step brings into the world: one or a list.

rewards.description: Paid when the step is done.

quest.description: A quest chain in the game's own journal, tracked-quest line and map: steps that run in order, each with objectives, and what it pays. The block's name is its id: keep it and the steps' ids. Players need the mod (clients "mod"). A quest from a blocks file is built into the game's journal from the next start, unless the mod ships quests/generated/<mod>.json.

giver.description: The NPC who offers it. A quest with a giver starts through that NPC, an action or code.

scope.description: player (default), party (players within partyRadius share credit, each gets rewards), world (one shared state).

auto.description: Starts by itself as soon as it is available.

retryable.description: Can start again after it failed or was given up (default true).

abandonable.description: Players may give it up (default true; never a world quest).

hidden.description: Not listed until it is active.

priority.description: Its order in the journal (the game uses 40..100; default 50).

if.description: Shown only while this holds; checked again when chosen.

goto.description: The next node: its text is the reply, and its options join the NPC's topics from then on. "end" or none: nothing more.

reply.description: What the NPC answers; default the target node's text.

voice.description: The reply's voice-over; default the target node's.

once.description: The topic goes away once heard.

close.description: The NPC plays its outro after the reply.

voice.description: A voice-over line the game's dialogue plays: a name in the mod's cooked audio, or a GUID.

hint.description: The marker over the NPC's head on this node's greeting.

options.description: Add new options at the end: positions and node names feed the lines' ids.

goto.description: A node without options: where "Continue" goes.

dialogue.description: A conversation in the game's own NPC menu: nodes of text and options, each with a condition and actions. An NPC block names it (talk). A conversation in chat (native: false) is quests/*.json's. Players need the mod (clients "mod").

greet.description: The start node's text is a greeting. Default: yes on a clone, no on a game NPC (its own greetings stay).

hint.description: The marker over the NPC's head on the greeting.

greetings.description: More greetings, shown before the plain one while their condition holds.

uiText.description: A text: plain, or one per language ({ "en": "Save", "de": "Speichern" }, "*" for every other language). The game's language picks it: the exact key ("pt-br"), the primary language ("pt"), then "en", then "*".

uiWhen.description: Shown only while this is true: a name (game.inGame, config.clock.show: true, not 0, not empty), !name, or name == value with == != < <= > >=, joined with &&. Examples: "game.inGame", "!game.inGame", "game.screen == InGame", "game.fps < 30 && config.hud.on".

uiBind.description: A value: game.<name> (fps, frameMs, state, inGame, screen, language, clock) or config.<path> of this mod's config (config.<config id>/<path> when two configs have the path).

uiSet.description: A config entry and the value to give it: true or false, a number in its range, or an option of an enum.

uiAction.description: What a button or a key does: exactly one of command, toggle, set, castAbility, applyEffect, openWindow, closeWindow, toast. Runs on the player's game, never on a dedicated server.

command.description: A command line of this game's command registry, as the console runs it: as the host's own character when this game hosts the world, else as the console. It does not reach a server this game joined.

castAbility.description: Asks the server to cast an ability of this mod (or "other-mod:name"), as its key would. The server needs the mod.

applyEffect.description: Applies an effect to the player, through a hidden ability named ui-apply.<name>. The server needs the mod.

openWindow.description: Opens a window block of this mod (or "other-mod:name").

toast.description: A short message in the corner of the screen.

uiRow.description: One line of a window. "type" says which: text, value, toggle, slider, choice, separator, button.

uiRowText.description: A line of text. {game.fps:0} and {config.clock.scale:0.00} in it show a value (refreshed at the window's pace); {{ and }} are braces.

sameLine.description: On the same line as the row before it.

tooltip.description: Shown while the pointer rests on the row's widget. May show values like a text row does.

wrap.description: Break long text at the window's edge. The overlay's wrapped text has no colour: not with color.

uiRowValue.description: A label and a value that cannot be edited here: Label: value.

sameLine.description: On the same line as the row before it.

tooltip.description: Shown while the pointer rests on the row's widget. May show values like a text row does.

format.description: How a number shows ("0", "0.00", "#,##0") or a true/false ("yes|no").

uiRowToggle.description: A checkbox on a true/false config entry. A click writes the config.

sameLine.description: On the same line as the row before it.

tooltip.description: Shown while the pointer rests on the row's widget. May show values like a text row does.

uiRowSlider.description: A slider on a whole-number or decimal config entry. A drag writes the config once it rests for a moment.

sameLine.description: On the same line as the row before it.

tooltip.description: Shown while the pointer rests on the row's widget. May show values like a text row does.

min.description: Default: the entry's own range, which it must have when min and max are left out.

uiRowChoice.description: A drop-down on an enum config entry, with its options.

sameLine.description: On the same line as the row before it.

tooltip.description: Shown while the pointer rests on the row's widget. May show values like a text row does.

uiRowSeparator.description: A line, with a heading when it has text.

sameLine.description: On the same line as the row before it.

tooltip.description: Shown while the pointer rests on the row's widget. May show values like a text row does.

uiRowButton.description: A button that runs an action.

sameLine.description: On the same line as the row before it.

tooltip.description: Shown while the pointer rests on the row's widget. May show values like a text row does.

uiColor.description: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, or white, black, gray, red, green, yellow, orange, cyan.

uiMenu.description: An entry in the game's pause menu and/or main menu that opens the window.

order.description: Lower first. Kiln's own Mods entry has 1000.

window.description: A window or a screen of rows: text, values, buttons, toggles, sliders, choices and separators. Drawn by each player's game from the mod's own file, so the mod needs "clients": "mod"; on a dedicated server it is checked and kept, and nothing is drawn. What it shows refreshes every "refresh" seconds, not every frame; a closed window costs nothing.

kind.description: window (default): an overlay window the player can drag. screen: a full screen in the game's look, dimming the game, closed by Escape.

width.description: Pixels at UI scale 1. 0: a window fits its rows, a screen is 720 wide.

height.description: Pixels at UI scale 1. 0: a window fits its rows, a screen is 520 high.

position.description: A window: where its centre is, [x, y] as 0..1 of the screen.

autoResize.description: A window: it grows and shrinks with its rows.

alpha.description: A window: how opaque the background is.

interactive.description: A window: false gives a panel the player only looks at (default true).

dim.description: A screen: darken the game behind it (default true).

openAtStart.description: Open as soon as the game has it. Default: closed until a key, a button or a menu entry opens it.

refresh.description: Seconds between updates of the values and conditions it shows. Default 0.25.

hudLine.description: A line of text on the game's screen. It shows while its condition holds and updates at its own pace; hidden, it costs nothing. Drawn by each player's game, so the mod needs "clients": "mod".

text.description: The text, with {game.fps:0} and {config.clock.scale:0.00} for values; {{ and }} are braces.

keyBinding.description: A key that runs an action. The player can rebind it in the Kiln menu's Keys tab; the choice is kept in keybinds.json under <mod>:<name>. Bound on each player's game, so the mod needs "clients": "mod".

key.description: The default key: F8, Ctrl+K, Shift+Alt+F2, Numpad5, or None to bind it only once the player chooses.

description.description: What the Keys tab says. Default: the block's name.

category.description: The group in the Keys tab. Default: the mod's name.

onGameScreens.description: A key that types something (a letter, a digit) fires in play only; true fires on every game screen too, chat included.

whileCapturing.description: Also fire while the Kiln menu is open.

affixName.x-kiln-message: lower-case letters, digits, '-' and '_', at most 64, starting with a letter or digit
affixName.description: An affix's or a pool's name, stricter than other blocks': rolled items keep "mod:name", so keep it.

affix.description: One kind of rolled modifier on an item (AffixBlock): its stat, and its tiers with the range each rolls in. A roll picks a tier, then a value in its range, and that value is what the one item carries.

name.x-kiln-message: a name players can read: 1 to 64 characters, not only spaces
name.description: What players read: "of the Bear", "Fleet". Kept with every roll.

stat.description: The stat it changes while its item is worn or in hand: a stat's key ("strength", "move-speed"), or a GUID for another attribute of the game (a share).

tiers.description: Its tiers, the weakest first: tier 1 is the first. At least one tier with a weight above 0 has minItemLevel 0.

stacks.description: Two worn items with it add up (true, the default), or only the highest value counts (false).

group.description: Affixes of one group never roll onto one item together ("prefix", "element").

affixTier.description: One tier of an affix: the range a roll of this tier takes its value from.

min.x-kiln-message: never 0: a value of 0 changes nothing
min.description: The lowest value: whole points for a whole-number stat (strength: 3), a share for the others (move-speed: 0.05 is 5 %). Negative values make a curse. Never 0, at most 1000000 either way.

max.x-kiln-message: never 0: a value of 0 changes nothing
max.description: The highest value: at least min, and of the same sign.

step.description: The grid a rolled value lies on. Default: 1 for a whole-number stat, 0.01 (one percent) for a share.

weight.description: How likely a roll takes this tier, among the tiers the item's level allows (default 1).

minItemLevel.description: The item level from which this tier can roll (default 0: any).

affixPool.description: Which items roll which affixes, and how many (AffixPoolBlock). A roll picks min to max different affixes by weight, never two of one group.

items.description: The item types that roll from it: game items, or items of this mod by their block name. Left out: any item with an item entity of its own (gear, tools).

min.description: How many different affixes a roll gives at least (default 1). A pool whose entries can never give that many (entries with a weight above 0, one per group) is refused.

max.description: How many at most (default 1): at least min.

affixEntry.description: One affix a pool can give.

affix.x-kiln-message: an affix's name, not only spaces
affix.description: An affix of this mod by its name (defined in code or in any blocks file of the mod), or "other-mod:name".

weight.description: How likely it is to come up, among the pool's (default 1).
